D: Identical twins meet at summer camp and swap places to get their parents back together.
P: Serve the snacks when Hallie and Annie share biscuits dipped in peanut butter.
S: Camp Walden choc biscuits and PB dip
the twins dunking chocolate biscuits in peanut butter in the isolation cabin

Chocolate cream sandwich biscuits with a whipped peanut butter and honey dip, salted pretzels on the side for the sweet and salty dunk. Beat 200g smooth peanut butter with 100g softened cream cheese, 2 tbsp honey, a pinch of salt and 60ml milk until light and fluffy. Spoon into a bowl and swirl a little extra honey through the top. Pile 2 packets of chocolate cream sandwich biscuits and 150g salted pretzels on a platter around the dip and let everyone dunk.
Cheddar, brie and goat's cheese with grapes, fig jam and walnuts
Aged cheddar, brie and goat's cheese on a board with bunches of red grapes, fig jam, toasted walnuts and crackers.
Light scones made with cream and lemonade, baked close together
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and clotted cream.
M: Roast beef eye fillet, creamy potato bake and a rich pan gravy
Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a rich pan gravy, potato gratin and green beans, served by candlelight.
Camping trip snags with fried onions
the camping trip where Meredith gets pranked

Thick beef sausages grilled on the barbecue, tucked into soft rolls with sticky fried onions and mustard, smoky baked beans on the side. Slice 3 onions and cook slowly in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 20 minutes until golden and sticky, adding a pinch of brown sugar at the end. Grill 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 minutes, turning often. Warm 2 tins baked beans with 1 tsp smoked paprika. Split 8 soft rolls, add a sausage, pile on onions and finish with mustard. Serve the beans on the side.
W: Strawberries, whipped cream and broken meringue folded together
Crushed meringue, softly whipped cream and quartered strawberries folded together in glasses, with a drizzle of strawberry purée sweetened with a little sugar.
K: Napa Valley grape and rosemary spritz
Red grape juice with rosemary syrup and frozen grapes

Chilled red grape juice with fresh lime and a rosemary syrup, topped with sparkling water and frozen grapes, served in wine glasses like the grown-ups. Simmer 60g caster sugar, 60ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Freeze a bunch of red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml chilled red grape juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Drop frozen grapes into 4 wine glasses, pour in the juice and top each with 80ml sparkling water. Finish with a small rosemary sprig.

note.text: We swapped places and Dad won't notice. We've practiced the handshake.

dishes.make_ahead: Toast the walnuts up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight; take the cheeses out of the fridge 30 minutes before and arrange on the day

steps.text: Bring the cheddar, brie and goat's cheese to room temperature.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan.
Arrange the cheeses on a wooden board with grapes, fig jam, walnuts and crackers.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead, keep airtight and rewarm at 160C for 5 minutes before serving with jam and clotted cream

steps.text: Mix the flour, cream and lemonade until just combined.
Pat out and cut into rounds.
Bake close together at 220C until risen and golden.
Cool slightly.
Serve warm with jam and clotted cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble the gratin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, and add 10 minutes to the bake; sear and roast the beef on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly and layer with cream and garlic in a dish.
Bake the potatoes at 180C.
Season the beef with salt and pepper and sear all over in the oil.
Roast the beef at 200C alongside the potatoes until medium-rare.
Rest the beef.
Deglaze the pan with beef stock and reduce until glossy.
Cook the green beans.
Serve by candlelight on a boat.

veg.n: Whole roast cauliflower with potato gratin
veg.make_ahead: Assemble the gratin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, and add 10 minutes to the bake; rub and roast the cauliflower on the day

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly and layer with the cream, crushed garlic and salt in a dish.
Bake the potatoes at 180C.
Rub the whole cauliflower with the oil, salt and pepper and roast alongside the potatoes for the last 50 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and reduce until glossy.
Cook the green beans.
Carve the cauliflower into thick wedges and serve with the gratin, gravy and beans by candlelight.

dishes.make_ahead: Hull the strawberries and make the sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whip the cream and assemble just before serving so the meringue stays crisp

steps.text: Hull the strawberries.
Blitz some of the strawberries with the sugar into a sauce and quarter the rest.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold in the broken meringue nests and the quartered strawberries.
Spoon into glasses and drizzle with the sauce.

dishes.n: Napa Valley grape and rosemary spritz
dishes.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and rosemary sprigs.
Cool and strain the syrup.
Freeze the grapes.
Mix the grape juice with the rosemary syrup and lime juice.
Drop frozen grapes into wine glasses, pour in the juice and top with sparkling water. Finish with a small rosemary sprig.

s.note: Cheddar, brie and goat's cheese with grapes, fig jam and walnuts
s.how: Bring 150g each of aged cheddar, brie and goat's cheese to room temperature. Arrange on a wooden board with bunches of red grapes, a pot of fig jam, toasted walnuts and a stack of crackers. Serve with the vineyard view.

s.note: Light scones made with cream and lemonade, baked close together
s.how: Mix 450g self-raising flour with 300ml cream and 300ml lemonade until just combined. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220C for 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and clotted cream.

m.note: Roast beef eye fillet, creamy potato bake and a rich pan gravy
m.how: Layer thinly sliced potatoes with cream and bake at 180C for an hour. Roast a 1kg beef eye fillet to medium-rare and rest. Deglaze the pan with beef stock and reduce until glossy. Serve with green beans by candlelight on a boat.

w.note: Strawberries, whipped cream and broken meringue folded together
w.how: Hull 500g strawberries. Blitz 100g of them with 1 tbsp sugar into a sauce and quarter the rest. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks, fold in 6 broken meringue nests and the quartered strawberries, spoon into 4 glasses and drizzle with the sauce.

Mix 600ml chilled red grape juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Drop frozen grapes into 4 wine glasses, pour in the juice and top each with 80ml sparkling water. Finish with a small rosemary sprig.
